clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, the Hidden Path climbs above the Valley of Trials toward Spirit Rock. Young shaman follow it to prove their awareness and discipline, while its high reaches look west toward the Barrens.

The Hidden Path climbs through red peaks above the Valley of Trials, hard to spot from the canyon floor. Mentors send young shaman along it to test their awareness and discipline before they commune with the spirits at Spirit Rock. From the highest reaches, you can see west across the rolling savannas of the Barrens.

The Hidden Path also cuts through the natural defenses around the valley. A low pass leads toward Ratchet and the road to Orgrimmar. It bypasses the usual canyon checkpoints, leaving defenders wary that Alliance infiltrators could use the quiet trail to reach the Horde's proving grounds.
